records.observation: Abstract grouped iterator. Constructor stores timeframe reference without copying and leaves objects_itr null; protected setter accepts iterator. hasNext immediatelyfalse if currentnull (does NOT invoke abstract nextObjGrpItr for initial setup). Otherwise asks current.hasNext; when exhausted repeatedly calls nextObjGrpItr(timeframe) until a nonempty group ornull; skips empty groups, progress relies on subclass returning advancing groups. next delegates current.next directly without hasNext/group advancement: null current throws, exhausted current behavior delegated. remove is silent no-op. Mutable timeframe can influence later group retrieval; no generic overlap filter, sorting, exceptions or copy. Subclasses must initialize first iterator and users must invoke hasNext across group boundaries.
